summary: Initial monorepo foundation with a deterministic, validated, reversible, replayable project-operation engine. TypeScript (pnpm) + Rust (Cargo) workspaces. All quality gates pass.
assumptions: The required-reading files (AGENTS.md, docs/product/product-spec.md, docs/architecture/system-architecture.md, docs/architecture/project-document.md) did not exist and were authored as part of this foundation.
.benchmark-lock.json is absent; per the prompt its absence is treated as out of scope and it was NOT created.
Cross-project error 'asset.projectId does not match current project' is reported as VALIDATION_ERROR (no dedicated code exists in the required error enum).
Range/duration violations (including sourceOutUs > durationUs and missing durationUs) return INVALID_TIME_RANGE; OUT_OF_BOUNDS is reserved for insertionIndex bounds.
Internal inverse commands are modeled as { commandType, payload } (no envelope); each is a pure function of prior state so replay can recompute and byte-compare them.
Each inverse carries restoreUpdatedAt (and insertionIndex where array position matters) so undo restores exact prior state without a full-project snapshot.
The legacy photo_editor.py at the repo root is unrelated and excluded from lint/format.
TypeScript packages are bundled with tsup (esbuild) so dist/index.js is a self-contained importable ESM entry; workspace deps stay external.
The Rust crates (media-core, timeline-engine, project-store) are honest minimal scaffolds with real domain primitives and unit tests; no media decoding or fake behavior.

coverage: canonical microsecond string rejection (negatives, decimals, exponents, whitespace, leading zeros, empty, non-string)
duplicate ids incl duplicate track indices
source ranges outside asset duration incl missing durationUs
half-open overlap rules and valid adjacency
failed-command atomicity and input immutability (deep-frozen inputs)
deterministic replay after JSON round trip
undo and redo for every command
delete-then-undo restoring exact clip order and values
new edit after undo clearing redo
two independent executions producing identical canonical JSON

commandsRun.outcome: PASS — 7 workspace projects built dist/ (incl. packages/editor-state/dist/index.js)

limitations: Rust crates are honest scaffolds: pixel/color type declarations, pure Rational/interval math, and canonical-microsecond + in-memory store primitives. Media decoding, render, playback, audio, and export are later roadmap phases.
Apps are minimal buildable scaffolds that boot the real editor-state engine; they implement no UI, transport, or media behavior.
Rust toolchain was installed during this session (rustup, stable + clippy + rustfmt) to run the cargo gates.
The persistence contract is in-memory only, per the prompt (no database).
